entities.name: Query Cu-Zn SOD
observations: 154 aa protein; homologs Q19VG9, B6QEB3, and Q9HEY7 are reviewed Cu/Zn superoxide dismutases with 82.5–85.7% identity and 100% query coverage.
Pfam Sod_Cu domain PF00080.26 spans residues 14–150, supporting a complete compact Cu/Zn SOD domain.

entities.name: Superoxide dismutation
observations: EC 1.15.1.1; Rhea RHEA:20696: 2 superoxide + 2 H+ → hydrogen peroxide + O2.

entities.name: Copper ion
observations: Cu2+/Cu ion is a catalytic cofactor; reviewed homologs bind one copper ion per subunit.

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: Zn2+ is a structural cofactor; reviewed homologs bind one zinc ion per subunit.

entities.name: Q19VG9
observations: Reviewed Talaromyces marneffei Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase; 85.7% identity and 100% coverage to the query; EC 1.15.1.1.

entities.name: Q9HEY7
observations: Reviewed Emericella nidulans Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase; 82.5% identity and 100% coverage to the query; EC 1.15.1.1.
